profile.headline: Trade Developer at Cardinal Capital Management
profile.summary: Analyst/Developer with strong programming and mathematical background.  Currently working on proprietary high frequency trading.

positions.title: Trade Developer
positions.description:
• Developed historical tool for converting option portfolio into past equivalent portfolio to see historical value and performance in different environments in Java.
• Designed and developed floor trader Java GUI interpretation system that allowed accessing trading information for complicated spreads with minimal key strokes.
• Developed overhaul of required edge calculation and position based price adjustment models in Java.
• Developed price feeds for CME, CFE, and CBOE options and futures exchanges in C++ for both in and out of process use.
• Implemented aggressive trading speed improvements (messaging improvements and a short cut of price feed processing to target customers) in C++.
• Implemented dynamic aggressive sizing based on available edge in C++ and Java.
• Developed operational improvements for management of trading algorithms and related systems (remote management, automated widening, and risk warnings) in Java and Python.

positions.title: Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed price feeds, gateways, and strategies across multiple cryptocurrency exchanges in C++ and Python.
• Researched trading strategies involving cryptocurrency portfolios and trading the Euro-USD exchange rate via cryptocurrencies using Jupyter.
• Shared 24-hour operational responsibility for trades running on AWS.

positions.title: Algorithmic Trader
positions.description:
• Designed and developed trade strategy software in C++ used across multiple desks; involved overall system design, relative value strategy, various microstructure signals, quoting, matching between internal strategies.
• Led design focus on testability leading to significant reduction of bug frequency and decrease of technical risk.
• Developed significant portions of trade library used firm wide across multiple trade frameworks.
• Provided primary operational support for crude futures desk and secondary support for several other desks in the commodity futures space; managed and mentored several junior developers on crude futures desk.
• Developed post order analysis system in Python leading to discovery of networking issue within firm.
• Performed audits of shared code for cleanliness and test coverage.
• Worked with head of core development on improving interfaces and general code quality of core platform.

positions.title: Analyst/Trade Developer
positions.description:
• Part of two-person team specializing in priority-based market making in CME futures.
• Researched microstructure signals in Python.
• Developed trade strategy software in C++.

positions.title: Analyst/Trade Developer
positions.description:
• Founding member of new trading team making $50k+ daily.
• Researched market signals (e.g., trade impact, priority estimation, quote change) and coded trading logic for trading S&P and interest rate futures.
• Designed and implemented back testing framework for signal testing and parameter optimization in Java and Python.
• Developed research platform and tool suite to allow traders to actively research their own signals and filter previous trades based on new signals in Java.
• Optimized production trades by developing post-trade analytic framework in Java and Python.
• Researched and developed trading software for aggressive lead-lag equity strategy in Java and Python.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: Contributed to the design and implementation of a coal flotation system.
